name: a5
description: Hai's S2 flow beside Ather Automata, which it never changes. A5 off: Ather exactly as it ships, plus the 🟥/⏯️ title marks. /a5 on: the five rules (D9), checked at the action only for what cannot be undone and at A5 acceptance (at Ather's Ship prompt, before a PR through gh or an MCP tool, at an intent close, and after the fact for a PR it never scored; a card in Ather's pane), and coordination for the sessions sharing one S2 checkout: Editor holder (queue, leases, the S2 standard's lock lines), RAM (safe cleanup, launch and PIE gates), Sync main holder (cutoff, a freeze that is a lease with a hard end, a sync worker that runs the merge, the MERGE_HEAD guard, conflicts to their owners), with a5 notices that never enter intent files, one compact A5 line of icons and values in Ather's pane (★ A5 › on seal red) and an A5 pane of its own (/a5, all in English): a thin seal-red band, one tools list, the open sessions, the acceptance card and five rule chips that open a card each; one-shot pixel dithers on the desktop.

a5WhenPresent.title: A5 approvals when you are here
a5WhenPresent.description: ask: a dialog asks you before a destructive git/fs command or a shared-config edit runs; deny: the agent is refused and must ask you to run it. A worker (subagent) is never asked: it is refused and reports. During an Ather away window the question goes to its ledger as a D-<n> and the call is refused.

motion.title: Pixel motion in Ather's pane
motion.description: on: a tile's pixel icon dithers in when its state turns over, the Branch icon sweeps while a sync runs, the A5 seal stamps in; off: every icon stays still.

launchGatePieGb.title: A5 Editor launch gate, slot with PIE (GB free)
launchGatePieGb.description: Free RAM, after the safe cleanup, a slot with PIE needs before the Editor is launched (an Editor already open is reused). /a5 gate <with PIE> <without PIE> moves it for every session; /a5 gate reset returns to this value. The PIE gate itself (start at 5 GB, abort under 3 GB) is fixed.

launchGateGb.title: A5 Editor launch gate, slot without PIE (GB free)
launchGateGb.description: Free RAM, after the safe cleanup, a slot without PIE needs before the Editor is launched.

syncMergeMinutes.title: A5 Sync main: freeze length for a merge (minutes)
syncMergeMinutes.description: The freeze from the sync time is a lease: past this many minutes without done or abort the sync expires, git and the Editor open again for every session, and Hai gets a 🟥.

syncBuildMinutes.title: A5 Sync main: freeze length for a merge with a build (minutes)
syncBuildMinutes.description: The same hard end for a sync planned with a build (/a5 sync HH:MM build, or Build: on in the panel's Sync ⋯ dialog).

pendingFile.title: Pending decisions file
pendingFile.description: Where 🟥 decisions outside Ather's records are appended (an intent's director call is in Ather's Needs you instead); empty means %USERPROFILE%/.claude/PENDING.md.
